Directly expanding first autocorrelation verifies Ad R1=A²e^{2iδ}conj(z)+U(z-U)+k conj(U). When z!=0 two circle intersections at most; equality of their R1 values equivalent to (s²-r²)z=k conj(z)^2. Nondegeneracy requires |r-s|<|k|<r+s (after solving |z|=|s²-r²|/|k|). When z=0, r=s and U constrained to circle; cubic U³+AdR1 U-kr²=0 bounds fiber by three, and two distinct nontrivial solutions occur iff 0<|k|<2r. Triple requires R1=R2=0 and |k|=r=s, achieved by three cubic roots. Explicit independent exact symbolic computation for j=0,1,2 verified all R0..R3=(65/4,0,0,2) for f_j=1-(3/2)ω^(-j)z+3ω^j z²+2z³ with ordered squared moduli (1,9/4,9,4). Nontrivial equivalence excludes reversal except at A=D,B=C, handled separately; lengths <=3 follow a single real-linear middle-tap equation. Completeness relies on the all-case analytic two-circle/cubic proof, not finite checks.
